task.title: Implement daemon dispatcher skeleton
task.summary: Add a bounded daemon dispatcher skeleton that can claim runnable daemon jobs, record attempts/heartbeats, enforce retry/block policy, and stop safely without spawning compiler sessions yet.

goal.outcome: Daemon dispatcher core can run one safe job attempt lifecycle without replacing compiler execution.
acceptance: Dispatcher claims one runnable job with locking/TTL semantics.
Retry/circuit breaker and stale-heartbeat behavior are deterministic.
Dispatcher has no unbounded autonomous loop in package tests; one-shot/tick mode is testable.
non_goals: Do not spawn Pi sessions in this task.
Do not define runtime model/provider policy beyond existing contracts.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Dispatcher claims one runnable job with locking/TTL semantics.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: runCodewikiDaemonDispatcherTick selects queued/retryable blocked jobs, starts one run with lease_expires_at, appends heartbeat, and returns after one tick; tests assert claimed run lease and heartbeat.
Dispatcher uses start/heartbeat/finish daemon lifecycle helpers and tests cover completed pass, failed attempts, blocked retry state, stale run state, and claimed running state.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Retry/circuit breaker and stale-heartbeat behavior are deterministic.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: applyDaemonRetryCircuitBreaker records retry_limit when attempts reach max_attempts; stale detection uses lease expiry or heartbeat age; tests cover retry-limit idle behavior and stale retry recovery.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Dispatcher has no unbounded autonomous loop in package tests; one-shot/tick mode is testable.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: runCodewikiDaemonDispatcherTick performs at most one stale marking or one claim/finish per call and tests invoke discrete ticks with deterministic timestamps.
